chapters.title: Customers: everyone who buys from us
chapters.text: This is Customers, everyone who buys from us, each with a G M number.

chapters.title: New customers are registered while you sell
chapters.text: New customers are registered while you sell. In Live, type a new phone number in the Who box, and the customer form opens. Fill it in and save.

chapters.title: Find a customer: search by name, phone or GM number
chapters.text: To find a customer, search by name, phone number or G M number.

chapters.title: Flags: customers missing a location, contact or email
chapters.text: Use Flags to find customers who are missing a location, a contact number or an email, so you can complete them.

chapters.title: Tap a customer to open their record
chapters.text: Tap a customer to open their record. Here you can correct their phone number, location and other details, then tap Save Changes.

chapters.title: Cancel or Save to see their receipts
chapters.text: When you are done, tap Cancel or Save Changes. The customer's summary shows how much they have bought, and all their receipts, newest first.

chapters.title: View / print any receipt
chapters.text: Tap View or print beside any receipt to see it again, or print it.

chapters.title: The laws and this video: 📜 Laws
chapters.text: That is Customers. The laws of this page, and this video, are on the Laws button.
